name: Luangwa Safari House
tagline: The ultimate private safari residence — your own wilderness estate
description: An exclusive-use private safari house on the banks of the Luangwa River. Luangwa Safari House offers the ultimate in privacy and personalized service — a fully staffed residence with four en-suite bedrooms, a private pool, and an open-plan living area that opens onto the river. Your own private safari camp, exactly as you imagine it.
longDescription:
Luangwa Safari House is an exclusive-use property that redefines the safari experience. Set within a private concession along the Luangwa River, this elegant residence accommodates up to eight guests in four spacious en-suite bedrooms. The house is designed for indoor-outdoor living: a central lounge and dining area opens onto a wide verandah with a private infinity pool overlooking the river. A dedicated team — including a private guide, chef, and butler — ensures every moment is tailored to your preferences. Game drives and walking safaris depart directly from the house, led by expert guides who bring the bush to life. Sundowners on the deck, bush dinners by lantern light, and the sounds of the African night create an intimacy that only an exclusive-use property can deliver.

The house features a master suite with a king-size bed, en-suite bathroom with indoor and outdoor showers, and direct views of the river. Three additional guest bedrooms each offer king or twin configuration with private facilities. The main living area includes a well-stocked bar, a library of safari books, and a fireplace for cool evenings.
priceRange: $2,000 to $5,000 per night (exclusive-use, up to 8 guests)
amenities: Exclusive-use property (you and your party only)
Private infinity pool overlooking the Luangwa River
Dedicated private guide, chef, and butler
romanticHighlights: Your own private villa on the river — complete privacy
Private chef preparing candlelit dinners on your deck
Sundowners as hippos surface in the river below
Exclusive game drives — just the two of you with a private guide
Stargazing from your private pool after the bush settles
